title: SQLAlchemy の session.query を 2.0 形式の select に書き換える
summary: 旧式の Query API を select と session.scalars に移し、execute のせいで Row が返るのを直し、チーム名の結合では execute を使う。

files.content:
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Team(Base):
    __tablename__ = "teams"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str]


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    email: Mapped[str]
    name: Mapped[str]
    is_active: Mapped[bool]
    created_at: Mapped[datetime]
    team_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("teams.id"))
    team: Mapped[Team] = relationship()

turns.user: SQLAlchemy 2.0 のドキュメント見たら session.query は legacy って書いてある。users.py 新しい書き方にしといて

from .models import Team, User


def active_users_with_team(session: Session) -> list[tuple[User, str]]:
    stmt = (
        select(User, Team.name)
        .join(User.team)
        .where(User.is_active)
        .order_by(User.created_at)
    )
    return [(user, team_name) for user, team_name in session.execute(stmt)]
